profile: As a developer I've contributed with a lot of enthusiasm to projects across AR, VR, mobile games and interactive installations. Connecting the virtual and physical world and my drive to explore the edges of what technology can do are central to my work. Every project is another chance to give people a fresh perspective.

education.note: Studied game development across individual and group projects: games, web applications, interactive installations and 3D. For my graduation project I researched AR-framework compatibility through cloud anchors and built my own framework integrating ARCore and ARKit before ARFoundation existed.
Led a team building an indie game telling the story of the Sámi, the last tribe of Europe. I guiding the project through every round and we won first place for the year.

offTheClock: Music production, baking, cooking, church, history, fitness
